tracks.name: Multilevel coarse-to-fine solver
tracks.hypothesis: A genuine size-adaptive Galerkin hierarchy reduces expensive fine-network corrections.
evidence: Galerkin operator, nullspace and transfer qualification on odd/rectangular grids
Frozen multilevel and numerical-only controls on common requests
Coupled timing and accuracy of any selected candidate

tracks.name: Student distillation
tracks.hypothesis: Training smaller students on successful full-model corrections recovers better convergence than channel slicing plus fine-tuning.
evidence: Intermediate and half-width students with an explicitly frozen completed teacher
Matched non-distillation controls and recorded optimizer/teacher work
Managed fits, fresh CPU restores and same-population accuracy/time

tracks.name: Model-generated state training
tracks.hypothesis: Training on states from model-driven native trajectories improves subsequent rollout behavior.
evidence: Longer matched native/surrogate rollouts recording velocity/tracer/pressure drift
Separate training-only on-policy state captures with same-equation labels
Matched replay continuation and on-policy fit, then independent rollouts

tracks.name: Neural preconditioner
tracks.hypothesis: Residual minimization inside a conventional iterative solver uses neural proposals more efficiently than repeated raw corrections.
evidence: Krylov or flexible residual-minimizing method with verified breakdown handling
Frozen neural and numerical preconditioner controls
Train for convergence inside the solver and compare with matched reconstruction objective

tracks.name: Data diversity and larger-grid diagnosis
tracks.hypothesis: More distinct forcing, rectangular shapes, frequencies and cold starts improve coverage more efficiently than grid size alone.
evidence: New whole-scene train/development/blind reservations before capture
Early bounded 256-cubed diagnostic with explicit memory/time limits
Matched original and diversified training with per-tier work and independent evaluation

tracks.name: Inference execution
tracks.hypothesis: Changing inference execution and repeated operator work lowers total policy cost without retraining.
evidence: Eager, traced/frozen and channels-last execution on identical real requests
Full forward/policy accuracy qualification and all conversions included
Repeated same-core inference and native IPC/fluid-step timing of selected execution

experiment_rules: Preserve qualified historical sources and original checkpoints
No use of consumed holdouts as blind evidence; reserve new whole scenes
Count all training and teacher work, setup, conversions and solver work
Pressure residual and predicted divergence gates remain unchanged
No hidden solver fallback or advancement after rejection
Do not declare the six-track campaign complete from a frozen screen alone
